test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-II Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic.

Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

WASH - HSWA - WSAH

NEST - TSNE - NSET
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0488b7c0daf98fa9fa0e852444d1bd45eb81cb2e556cd44c4fcac08bf72271ed.png] 

The logic followed here is:

WASH - HSWA - WSAH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02e666263067477d06538756f8b78f63364d8ca463564d0ed6daaa24737ef20a.png] 

And,

NEST - TSNE - NSET 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/029a7216fcbe2f289b4b7c92a16f3c11730f194ec412958e26066fcad6c21418.png] 

Similarly,

OILS - SLOI - OLIS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14741f0e9e86639c9d4b29faada51daa9bb4b0d35aacfe7d2100cea1095dedd4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
